headline: F1 agrees a ten-year deal for an African Grand Prix in Rwanda
body: Formula 1 plans to return to Africa in the early 2030s under a ten-year agreement with Rwanda. A new circuit will be built in Bugesera, around 40km south of Kigali; the inaugural race date has yet to be announced. It would be F1's first African race since the 1993 South African Grand Prix.
